decoder.buildStatus: inferred schema version; not independently verified game client build

checkpoint.method: Every reused raw definition, zone and paste record independently redecode-compared byte-for-byte JSON against the pinned current copied cache; no terrain repeated.

coverage.comparisonAddressScope: All 2350 picker crop addresses plus retained addresses outside the crop and interior/nonnumeric keys. The 6468 unknown retained groups are not all missing crop coverage.

comparison.normalization: Strip client HTML, retained Wiki wrappers and asterisks; collapse whitespace and lowercase. Numeric IDs and tile positions unavailable in old reference.
comparison.renameLimit: No old numeric object IDs or tile positions: no defensible rename pairing. Count differences are advisory.

replacementEstimate.unit: retained normalized name/chunk groups, not individual objects or migration-ready entries

doorReview.proposal: Join succeeds without granting access. Inspect branch clipping and server/quest constraints; obtain independent passability evidence before any openable-evidence input.

cohortActions.open-close-action-needs-passability-evid: Inspect open/closed branch clipping and independently verify server/quest/member access before granting passage.
cohortActions.conditional-state-review: Resolve player-specific selector state and independently verify passability; keep all raw branches.
cohortActions.destination-or-server-rule-review: Identify destination and server requirements independently; action text is insufficient.

extractionHistory.v1: Raw definitions/layout checkpoints completed; source serialization failed at V8 single-string limit. These raw checkpoints independently passed all-record redecoding.
extractionHistory.v2: Partial streaming attempt preserved; stopped after verified own importer process inspection to replace millions of small gzip writes with bounded buffering.
extractionHistory.v3: Complete buffered streaming export; raw definition/layout checkpoints reused, source placement/terrain archives scanned afresh. Output hashes and source/archive/schema hashes recorded.
